name: firestore-rules-tests
description: Firestore rules + stockStore tests against the emulator (never production). Separate from the app build. Run: npm install, then npm test. Needs Java 21+ (Android Studio jbr works).

scripts.test: node build-store-test.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-rules-test --config ../../firebase.json "node --test --test-concurrency=1 rules.test.mjs out/stockStore.test.mjs out/prepStock.test.mjs out/paidOrdersCache.test.mjs out/orderPhotosMigration.test.mjs out/menuOptions.test.mjs out/optionsMigration.test.mjs"
